The chemical comparison with G31 suggests that AG318$-$c9 is a less evolved hot core dominated by the recent sublimation of ice mantles, in contrast to the higher abundances observed in the possible more evolved G31.
MF emerges as an excellent tracer of the gas temperature in HMCs owing to its wide spatial extent and wide dynamic range of the excitation temperature.
